comment: Both sx-settings and @slicerx/settings must produce exactly these keys. Generated by scripts/gen-easy-cases.py from the Easy mode concept formulas plus the flow and acceleration caps.

cases.name: defaults on x1c are the reference 0.20 mm setup
speed fastest is limited by accel and flow
saved speed gentle and maximum read as quality and fastest
mk4s fastest hits the flow cap
mk4s fine detail raises shell layers
vary layer height at the standard detail
vary layer height at strength 70 uses the Strength mode
smart layer quality at detail 100 narrows the bounds
smart layer quality at detail 0 uses the full window
smart layer on a 0.6 mm nozzle
smart layer on a 0.2 mm nozzle
smart layer keeps scalar values scalar
smart layer on a config with no nozzle
smart layer off resets the mode
saved speed silent reads as quality
saved speed ludicrous and supports everywhere
saved smartLayer strength keeps its mode at low strength
